File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn version_compaction(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse semicolon-separated version:key=value changes. Versions are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..9223372036854775807. Keys start with a lowercase ASCII letter and contain lowercase letters or digits separated by single interior hyphens. Values may contain = but not semicolon. Keep the greatest-version value per key; reject duplicate key+version pairs. Return sorted key=value@version records joined by semicolons.
Visible example: 2:mode=fast;1:mode=safe;3:zone=west returns mode=fast@2;zone=west@3.

reference.code: use std::collections::{BTreeMap,HashSet};pub fn version_compaction(input:&str)->Option<String>{let mut d:BTreeMap<&str,(i64,&str)>=BTreeMap::new();let mut seen=HashSet::new();for r in input.split(';'){let(left,val)=r.split_once('=')?;let(v,k)=left.split_once(':')?;if !(v=="0"||!v.starts_with('0')&&!v.is_empty()&&v.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit()))||k.split('-').any(|x|x.is_empty()||!x.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()||!x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))||!seen.insert((k,v)){return None}let n:i64=v.parse().ok()?;if d.get(k).is_none_or(|x|n>x.0){d.insert(k,(n,val));}}Some(d.into_iter().map(|(k,(v,x))|format!("{}={}@{}",k,x,v)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(";"))}
